author: Danny Garrison
title: 2026 Post-Draft Power Rankings
body:
Against all odds, the FFFFL is entering its fifth season. We started this league with a mix of complete novices, casual fantasy players, and degenerate sickos who mock draft year-round. Some of you didn't know a waiver wire from a liability waiver.

Now you're stashing handcuffs and optimizing roster builds with high-ceiling stacks. Through grit, determination, and many phone calls to have me personally walk you through the mechanics of the ESPN fantasy website, you're all sickos now. I couldn't be more proud.

To commemorate the start of FFFFL Season 5, I'm launching this website as a home for league history. Take a look at past drafts, rivalry records, managers' trophy cases, and more. There's lots to explore.

And for the first time ever in the FFFFL, we have power rankings.

## 1. Liz | 2025: 9-5, made playoffs
Liz is an absolutely fundamental roster builder. Perfectly balanced in every way. Sometimes not knowing who these guys are and just filling out the positions in front of you pays off.
[roster]
QB: Trevor Lawrence
RB: Ashton Jeanty, Travis Etienne Jr., Rico Dowdle, Jordan Mason, Justice Hill
WR: Puka Nacua, Tetairoa McMillan, Rome Odunze, Keenan Allen, Calvin Ridley, Jalen Nailor
TE: Dalton Kincaid
[/roster]

## 2. Andrew | 2025: 6-7-1, missed playoffs
For someone who I sniped all night because we were drafting off of the same rankings, Andrew still managed to get a roster full of players I like.
[roster]
QB: Joe Burrow
RB: James Cook III, Kenneth Walker III, Jonah Coleman, Emmett Johnson
WR: DeVonta Smith, Garrett Wilson, Josh Downs, Jayden Reed, KC Concepcion, Ja'Kobi Lane
TE: Kyle Pitts Sr., Terrance Ferguson
[/roster]

## 3. Danny | 2025: 7-7, missed playoffs
I took Ja'Marr Chase over Bijan Robinson because I didn't want to build my team around a guy on a bad offense, then proceeded to load up on different guys on bad offenses.
[roster]
QB: Justin Herbert
RB: Breece Hall, Bhayshul Tuten, J.K. Dobbins, Braelon Allen
WR: Ja'Marr Chase, Christian Watson, Quentin Johnston, De'Zhaun Stribling, Denzel Boston, Jordyn Tyson, Chris Bell
TE: Brock Bowers
[/roster]

## 4. Jess | 2025: 4-10, missed playoffs
This is just Jake's roster with better PR (Jahmyr Gibbs).
[roster]
QB: Patrick Mahomes, Tyler Shough
RB: Jahmyr Gibbs, MarShawn Lloyd, Isiah Pacheco, Ray Davis
WR: Rashee Rice, Chris Olave, Luther Burden III, Mike Evans, Jordan Addison
TE: Jake Ferguson, Chig Okonkwo
[/roster]

## 5. Jared | 2025: 8-6, made playoffs
Choosing to back up CMC with two more injury-prone running backs is a choice.
[roster]
QB: Brock Purdy
RB: Christian McCaffrey, D'Andre Swift, Jonathon Brooks, RJ Harvey, Tyler Allgeier
WR: Drake London, Zay Flowers, Parker Washington, Deebo Samuel Sr., Adonai Mitchell
TE: Tyler Warren, Dalton Schultz
[/roster]

## 6. Darren | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
There will be a random week when Darren gets 2 combined points from his WR position. If he can withstand that without deleting the ESPN fantasy app from his phone, his team could make some noise this season.
[roster]
QB: Drake Maye, Baker Mayfield
RB: Jonathan Taylor, Omarion Hampton, Kyren Williams, Aaron Jones Sr., Najee Harris
WR: Jaylen Waddle, DK Metcalf, Romeo Doubs, Rashid Shaheed, Caleb Douglas
TE: Travis Kelce
[/roster]

## 7. Tricia & Jeff | 2025: 7-6-1, made playoffs
I see the vision here. Someone in that WR corps should emerge as a WR2, and same goes for the collection of RBs. I see less of the vision with the two TEs.
[roster]
QB: Matthew Stafford
RB: Saquon Barkley, David Montgomery, Kyle Monangai, Woody Marks
WR: CeeDee Lamb, Chris Godwin Jr., Stefon Diggs, Alec Pierce, Tank Dell, Malachi Fields
TE: Trey McBride, Tucker Kraft
[/roster]

## 8. Team QCC | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
The Cowboys Mega Stack is risky but the Cowboys are going to the Super Bowl this year so I'll allow it.
[roster]
QB: Dak Prescott, Sam Darnold
RB: Javonte Williams, Rhamondre Stevenson, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Tank Bigsby
WR: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, George Pickens, Wan'Dale Robinson, Xavier Worthy, Jerry Jeudy
TE: Mark Andrews, Hunter Henry
[/roster]

## 9. Jake | 2025: 9-5, champion
Someone get this man an RB2, stat.
[roster]
QB: Caleb Williams, Malik Willis
RB: Chase Brown, Chris Rodriguez Jr., Zach Charbonnet
WR: A.J. Brown, Ladd McConkey, Courtland Sutton, Brian Thomas Jr., Michael Wilson, Jalen Coker, Germie Bernard
TE: Colston Loveland
[/roster]

## 10. Ryan | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
There's some synergy here. Cam Skattebo is like if Derrick Henry was a moron.
[roster]
QB: Bo Nix, C.J. Stroud
RB: Derrick Henry, Cam Skattebo, Rachaad White, Alvin Kamara
WR: Nico Collins, Jameson Williams, Michael Pittman Jr., Khalil Shakir, Rashod Bateman
TE: Sam LaPorta, Isaiah Likely
[/roster]

## 11. Kevin | 2025: 4-10, last place
I'm sorry Kevin but if Bijan Robinson has a league winner season then I look like a moron so I have to be your biggest hater this year.
[roster]
QB: Jaxson Dart, Kyler Murray
RB: Bijan Robinson, Jeremiyah Love, Tony Pollard, Blake Corum, Dylan Sampson
WR: Malik Nabers, DJ Moore, Marvin Harrison Jr., Jaylin Noel
TE: Dallas Goedert, T.J. Hockenson
[/roster]

## 12. Ken & Larry | 2025: 10-4, made playoffs
Josh Allen is no stranger to carrying a team, but this will test him.
[roster]
QB: Josh Allen, Jordan Love
RB: De'Von Achane, Bucky Irving, Chuba Hubbard, Tyjae Spears
WR: Davante Adams, Terry McLaurin, Matthew Golden, Jakobi Meyers, Tre Tucker, Kayshon Boutte
TE: George Kittle
[/roster]

## 13. Mark | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
You all laughed when Mark took both Lamar Jackson and Jayden Daniels, but you won't be laughing when one of them gets injured and he still has the other one to save his season, but then you can start laughing again once they're both injured.
[roster]
QB: Lamar Jackson, Jayden Daniels
RB: TreVeyon Henderson, Jaylen Warren, Josh Jacobs, Keaton Mitchell, Brian Robinson Jr.
WR: Amon-Ra St. Brown, Tee Higgins, Makai Lemon, Jalen McMillan
TE: Harold Fannin Jr., Juwan Johnson
[/roster]

## 14. Jon | 2025: 9-5, runner-up
I don't know if I've ever seen a draft where I could describe every single pick as "risky," until now.
[roster]
QB: Jalen Hurts, Jared Goff
RB: Jadarian Price, Quinshon Judkins, Kenny Gainwell, Mike Washington Jr., Kaelon Black
WR: Justin Jefferson, Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate, Travis Hunter
TE: Kenyon Sadiq, Brenton Strange
[/roster]
